reasons.specificity: The audit precisely distinguishes the article’s identity, causal-structural, capitalism, normative-adjudication, and historical-conjecture suppositions and tracks their separate roles.
reasons.anchoring: All ledger quotations occur in the supplied article and generally support the attributed antecedents, bridges, modal force, and qualified conclusions.
reasons.non_obviousness: It usefully distinguishes loss of Honneth’s specified theoretical identity from substantive inadequacy and sole-framework insufficiency from the stronger claim of failure for every pathology.
reasons.coherence: The prose, dependency tables, robustness table, and ledger remain consistently attributed, though repeated scope sections and shifting references to F1’s universal versus narrower consequence add minor friction.
reasons.usefulness: The scenarios, dependencies, alternatives, and robustness tests are highly useful with the text open, but the artifact greatly exceeds the requested one-page format and duplicates substantial material.
reasons.hallucination_risk: The analysis carefully labels its reconstructions and proposed controlled test, and it explicitly limits the article’s universal and optimality claims rather than presenting them as demonstrated.

score.one_line: A highly accurate, source-specific suppositional audit with excellent inferential distinctions, chiefly weakened by severe overlength and duplication relative to the requested one-page artifact.
